title: Endpoint values of the biased probability polynomial
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $f$ be a monotone, nonconstant function from the $n$-dimensional sign cube to $\\{\pm1\}$. The biased minus-probability polynomial associated with $f$ equals $0$ at parameter $p=0$ and equals $1$ at parameter $p=1$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a function from the $n$-dimensional sign cube to $\{\pm1\}$
